nodes.label: Ollama Deployment
nodes.rationale: Uses an initContainer (pull-phi3-model) that starts a temporary `ollama serve`, runs `ollama pull phi3` against it, then kills the process before the main container starts. This pre-warms the phi3 model onto the shared PVC so the main Ollama container does not incur a cold-start model download on first inference request.

nodes.label: Pod Security Hardening Pattern
nodes.rationale: All app/ai-tier Deployments (frontend, judge0, notification, ollama, proctoring, student) share an identical hardening template: pod-level runAsNonRoot/runAsUser 1000/fsGroup 1000, container-level allowPrivilegeEscalation:false with capabilities.drop:[ALL] and a configurable readOnlyRootFilesystem, an emptyDir tmp-dir mount to support the read-only root filesystem, and preferred podAntiAffinity keyed on app.kubernetes.io/name to spread replicas across nodes for availability. This is a deliberate least-privilege + high-availability convention applied uniformly across services rather than an incidental duplication.

nodes.label: Frontend Service Deployment
nodes.rationale: Stateless React SPA - 2 replicas for load distribution

nodes.label: Notification Service Deployment
nodes.rationale: BullMQ email worker - single replica processes Redis queue

nodes.label: ollama Deployment
nodes.rationale: Uses an initContainer to pre-pull the phi3 model into a persistent volume before the main container starts serving, avoiding repeated model downloads on pod restarts; scheduled on a dedicated AI node pool via nodeSelector/tolerations.

nodes.label: postgres Deployment (demo)
nodes.rationale: FOR DEMO/EVALUATION ONLY; production uses Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server instead of an in-cluster Postgres pod with emptyDir storage.

nodes.label: proctoring Deployment
nodes.rationale: Runs 2 replicas for the WebSocket proctoring service and hardens the container with runAsNonRoot, no privilege escalation, and dropped Linux capabilities.

nodes.label: redis Deployment (demo)
nodes.rationale: FOR DEMO/EVALUATION ONLY; production uses Azure Cache for Redis Standard C1 instead of an in-cluster Redis pod.

nodes.label: judge0-worker (docker-compose)
nodes.rationale: Runs privileged with /sys/fs/cgroup mounted; required for the compiler sandbox runtime isolation used by Judge0 workers.

nodes.label: Azure Workload Identity
nodes.rationale: Pods authenticate to Azure resources by exchanging an injected OIDC token with Azure AD for an access token, avoiding persistent connection secrets or passwords stored in the cluster.

nodes.label: Smart AI Proctoring
nodes.rationale: Uses computer vision (YOLO + InsightFace) for face verification, multi-face detection, book/phone detection, tab-switching limits, and fullscreen exit tracking to secure remote exams without human proctors.

nodes.label: Isolated Coding Sandbox
nodes.rationale: Code execution runs inside secure, resource-constrained containers (Judge0) so untrusted student-submitted code cannot affect the host or other tenants.

nodes.label: Automated Grading Engine
nodes.rationale: Integrates a locally-hosted LLM (Ollama phi3) to grade descriptive answers automatically instead of relying on external paid LLM APIs, keeping grading data on-cluster.
